Kingston DataTraveler Exodia 128GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive

Experience quick and effortless data transfers with the highly dependable Kingston DataTraveler Exodia 128GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-capacity storage hardware solution leverages USB 3.2 Gen 1 performance to ensure smooth data tracking and seamless file sharing across digital devices. It stands as the definitive choice for students, professionals, and tech enthusiasts across Egypt looking for a lightweight, on-the-go hardware modification to store essential software configurations, media backups, and system files.

The Kingston DataTraveler Exodia features a practical, user-friendly design equipped with a protective cap that safely covers the USB connector, along with a bright, color-coded loop that easily attaches to keyrings. Backed by Kingston's legendary reliability engineering, this ultra-portable 128GB storage module connects effortlessly to desktop PCs, modern laptops, smart TVs, and multi-media monitors, enhancing your overall storage ecosystem.
